tools.name: find_clinics
tools.description: Find clinics near a place, in a town or by name, nearest first. Each clinic has its clinic_id, address, distance, phone numbers with call/SMS/WhatsApp channels, hours today, open now and rating. Give near (latitude/longitude) or place (a town, place name or four-digit postal code). With treatment_id

tools.name: get_clinic
tools.description: One clinic's facts: address, phones, the week's opening hours (also odd and even weeks), closed days, parking, team, treatment categories with prices, current offers, payment methods, cancellation notice, gift cards and subscriptions.

tools.name: find_practitioners
tools.description: Find a practitioner by name (at least two letters) and the clinics where each can be booked now. For who can do one treatment option, with prices, use get_booking_choices.

tools.name: search_treatments
tools.description: Search treatments in Norwegian and English at once; spelling mistakes and compound words are handled. Each result has its treatment_id, category path, price from-to, offer price, duration, clinic count and, with near or place, the nearest clinics. Filter by category, body_area or skin_concern (brows

tools.name: get_treatment
tools.description: One treatment: what it is, the procedure, recovery and safety, sessions and interval, its options with option_id, price, offer price and duration, the clinics that offer it and its reviews. Every option has a booking_url.

tools.name: get_booking_choices
tools.description: The choices the booking lightbox offers for one option_id. Without a clinic: every clinic that can book it, with distance, practitioner count and prices. With clinic_id: the practitioners with their own prices (practitioner_id), add-ons, packages, party size, cancellation notice and payment methods.

tools.name: find_free_days
tools.description: Which days have a free time for one option_id, for up to 60 days, at clinic_id or at the three nearest clinics to near or place. For one practitioner_id or anyone; add_on_ids lengthen the visit. No free day gives a waitlist_url.

tools.name: find_free_times
tools.description: The free times on a date (or up to 7 days) for one option_id at clinic_id, with the practitioners free at each time and their prices. Every time has a booking_url that opens the booking lightbox with the option, practitioner, day, time and add-ons chosen. A time is not held until the person books it

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: The live offers (campaigns), with each treatment or product, its price before and after, and until when it holds. Filter by clinic_id, item_type or item_slug; offer_id reads one offer.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search skincare and retail products: GLØDI's marketplace on glodi.no and each clinic's shop on its own site. Filter by brand, category or stock. product_id reads one product with its description, sellers, subscription options, matching treatments and reviews.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Upcoming arrangements and courses, GLØDI's own and the clinics', with sessions, seats left, price from and registration state. event_id reads one event with its program, prerequisites and price tiers.

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.description: Published reviews and their summary (average, count, distribution) for one clinic_id, practitioner, treatment_id or product_id.

tools.name: browse_site
tools.description: The map of everything public here: every list page with its count, and the treatment categories, body areas and skin concerns with their slugs, for vague needs ("pigmentering", "acne"). Also the contact facts. GLØDI's own offer for clinics is glodi_for_business.

tools.name: read_public_page
tools.description: Read one public page, normally a URL another answer returned: its text sections, links, schema.org facts and typed data for the page type (clinic, treatment, practitioner, offer, product, brand, event, guide, article, ingredient or job).

tools.name: glodi_for_business
tools.description: GLØDI's offer for clinics and practitioners (glodi.no/bedrift): every module with what it does, its features, its monthly price and how modules combine (levels, included and free modules, the base module); GLØDI Platinum; the subscription terms (VAT, monthly billing, notice, no minimum term); usage

tools.name: price_modules
tools.description: The monthly price of a set of modules (module_id from glodi_for_business) as GLØDI invoices it: each line, modules included at 0 kr, the base module added when the others need it, a public promo code, VAT, and an apply_url with these modules chosen.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book one free time for a person, paid at the clinic. Give option_id, clinic_id, date and time from find_free_times, and the person's name and mobile number (practitioner_id and add_on_ids if chosen). Nothing is booked yet: a code goes to the person by SMS, and the answer has the price, the place and

tools.name: confirm_with_code
tools.description: Finish an action with the code the person received: book_appointment books the visit, find_my_bookings lists their coming bookings, join_waitlist files the request, send_inquiry sends the question to the clinic, request_demo sends the demo request, and buy_gift_card, register_for_event and order_pro

tools.name: find_my_bookings
tools.description: Send a code to the mobile number or email a person's bookings were made with; confirm_with_code then lists the coming bookings and gives a contact_proof for cancel_booking. Bookings in a GLØDI account are managed on Min side after signing in.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel one of the person's bookings with the contact_proof confirm_with_code gave, within the clinic's cancellation notice. Ask the person to confirm first. Nothing is refunded here; a paid visit is settled by the clinic.

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: Put a person on the clinic's waiting list for one option when no free time suits: dates, parts of the day and a practitioner if wanted. A code goes to their phone, then confirm_with_code. The clinic sends an SMS when a time frees up; nothing is held.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Send one clinic a question or a call-back request for a person when a booking does not fit: a treatment the clinic books after a consultation, a question the facts do not answer, or "call me". Give clinic_id, the message in the person's words, their name and mobile number or email, and treatment_id

tools.name: buy_gift_card
tools.description: Buy a gift card for a person, paid online: the clinic's own (clinic_id) or GLØDI's on glodi.no. Give the amount, the buyer's name, mobile number and e-mail, and the recipient if it is a present. A code goes to the buyer; confirm_with_code then answers with the payment link, also sent by e-mail. Noth

tools.name: register_for_event
tools.description: Register a person for an arrangement or course: session_id for one session or arrangement_id for the whole one (from list_events), pricing_tier_id when it has tiers, and the person's name, mobile number and e-mail. A code goes to the person; confirm_with_code registers them and, for a paid arrangeme

tools.name: order_products
tools.description: Order a clinic's products for pickup at the clinic, paid online: clinic_id and product_id with quantity from search_products, and the person's name, mobile number and e-mail. A code goes to the person; confirm_with_code orders and answers with the payment link.

tools.name: request_demo
tools.description: Ask the GLØDI team for a demo access code for a person interested in GLØDI: their name and email or mobile number. A code goes there, then confirm_with_code. The team answers by hand.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_treatment, search_products, list_reviews, read_public_page · Private data: browse_site, confirm_with_code, send_inquiry · Public sink: find_clinics, glodi_for_business, book_appointment, find_my_bookings, join_waitlist, send_inquiry, request_demo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_treatment, search_products, list_reviews, read_public_page · Private data: browse_site, confirm_with_code, send_inquiry · Public sink: find_clinics, glodi_for_business, book_appointment, find_my_bookings, join_waitlist, send_inquiry, request_demo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "browse_site" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The map of everything public here: every list page with its count, and the treatment categories, body areas and skin concerns with their slugs, for vague needs ("pigmentering", "acne"). Also the contact facts and, on glodi.no, GLØDI's plans for clinics." → after: "The map of everything public here: every list page with its count, and the treatment categories, body areas and skin concerns with their slugs, for vague needs ("pigmentering", "acne"). Also the contact facts. GLØDI's own offer for clinics is glodi_for_business."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
